# Calcyfy — Free Online Calculators & Converters

> Calcyfy (https://calcyfy.com) provides over 100+ free, instant, privacy-focused online calculators and unit converters across finance, health, math, date & time, construction, and everyday utilities.

## Overview
- Website: https://calcyfy.com/
- Description: Fast, privacy-centric calculators with zero sign-up required and full client-side calculation capability.
- Supported Languages: English (en), Arabic (ar), Spanish (es), French (fr), German (de).
- License / Terms: Free for public and educational use.

## Core Categories & Available Tools

### 1. Financial Calculators
- [Percentage Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/percentage): Calculate percentage increases, decreases, fractions, and discounts.
- [Loan & EMI Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/loan): Amortization schedules, monthly payments, interest totals.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/mortgage): Real estate loans, PMI, property tax, and payoff schedules.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/compound-interest): Investment projections with periodic deposits.
- [Salary & Net Pay Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/salary): Hourly to annual gross/net pay converter with tax deductions.
- [Tip & Bill Split Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/tip): Tip percentages, split totals across parties.
- [Discount & Sale Price Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/discount): Final price after multiple discounts and sales tax.
- [ROI & CAGR Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/roi-cagr): Return on investment and compound annual growth rate.
- [Crypto Profit / Loss Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/crypto-profit): Exit prices, ROI, fees, and breakeven.

### 2. Health & Fitness Calculators
- [BMI Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/bmi): Body Mass Index calculation with WHO classifications and healthy weight ranges.
- [Calorie & TDEE Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/calorie): Daily calorie requirements for maintenance, cutting, and bulking using Mifflin-St Jeor & Harris-Benedict formulas.
- [Body Fat Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/body-fat): US Navy method tape measurements.
- [BMR Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/bmr): Basal Metabolic Rate calculations.
- [Ideal Weight Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/ideal-weight): Devine, Robinson, Miller, and Hamwi formulas.
- [Water Intake Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/water-intake): Daily hydration needs by weight and activity.

### 3. Date & Time Calculators
- [Age Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/age): Exact chronological age in years, months, days, hours, countdown to next birthday, and zodiac signs.
- [Date Difference Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/date-diff): Calendar days, business working days (Mon-Fri), and hours between dates.
- [Time Zone Converter](https://calcyfy.com/tool/time-zone): Live multi-city time difference comparisons.

### 4. Math & Science Calculators
- [Scientific Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/scientific): Advanced trigonometric, logarithmic, powers, and exponential functions.
- [Unit Converter](https://calcyfy.com/tool/unit-converter): Length, weight, volume, temperature, area, speed, data sizes.
- [GPA Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/gpa): Cumulative and semester grade point average (4.0 & 5.0 scales).
- [Fraction Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/fraction): Add, subtract, multiply, and divide fractions.
- [Area & Perimeter Calculator](https://calcyfy.com/tool/area-perimeter): Geometric 2D shapes calculations.

## Privacy & Agentic Access
- No authentication cookies or tracking pixels required.
- All calculator formulas execute deterministically on client inputs.
- Safe for autonomous AI Agent search, retrieval, and embed workflows.
